manual_task: Read the form, check the CRM for the contact, research the company, add or update the CRM row, write a first reply
assumption: Volume: about 30 form leads a week. Review = read the AI summary and edit/send the draft. Flagged = a person qualifies the lead from the pre-filled record.

manual_task: Open the PDF, key the header and lines into the accounting system, check GST, totals and the PO
assumption: Volume: about 50 supplier invoices a week. Review = approve a pre-filled draft bill. Flagged = a person resolves an exception with the fields already extracted.

manual_task: Read the email, categorise and prioritise it, look up the order, write a reply
assumption: Volume: about 140 emails a week. Review = check and send the drafted reply. Flagged = a person handles it, with the category and a draft already in the ticket.

manual_task: Export yesterday's sales, update the spreadsheet, work out the KPIs and write the morning update
assumption: One digest a day. Review = read the posted digest. Flagged is not used: a rejected AI text is replaced by the template automatically.

manual_task: Check the request against the policy, find the right approver, chase the approval by email, record it
assumption: Volume: about 20 purchase requests a week. Review = glance at an auto-approval or return. Flagged = the approver reads the summary and submits the form.

manual_task: Read the blog post and write three channel-specific social posts
assumption: Two blog posts a week. Review = edit and schedule three drafts that passed every check. Flagged = drafts that failed a check need more editing.
